title: Build a Template Compiler
short_description: Parse a reduced template grammar and generate a render function that creates VNodes.
description: The compiler accepts elements, text, interpolations, nested children, and multiple root nodes. Attributes and directives remain outside this reduced grammar.
Complete the parse, transform, and code-generation stages while preserving clear errors for malformed templates.
instructions: Implement baseParse(template) so it returns a Root AST and consumes the entire source.
Implement interpolation parsing for {{ expression }}, trimming the expression and rejecting a missing closing delimiter.
Implement element parsing with matching start and end tags, nested children, and an explicit error for a missing or mismatched closing tag.
Implement text parsing so it stops at the next interpolation or element boundary without leaving the parser stuck.
Complete transform(ast) so every node receives a codegenNode and every interpolation is generated as a read from _ctx.
Complete generate(ast) so one root child returns that expression and multiple root children return an array.
Complete compile(template) so it returns both the transformed AST and the generated render-function source.

hints.title: Consumption
hints.body: Every parser branch must remove characters from `context.source`. Text should stop at the closest `{{` or `<` boundary.

hints.title: Ancestor stack
hints.body: Push the current element before parsing its children and pop it afterward. `isEnd()` can then stop when the next closing tag belongs to an active ancestor.

hints.title: Code generation
hints.body: Generate text with `JSON.stringify()`, interpolation as `String(_ctx.expression)`, and elements as `h(tag, null, children)`.

hints.title: Root shape
hints.body: A single root child can be returned directly. For multiple roots, generate an array so no source node disappears.
